cohort: The cohort comprised 159 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (cases) and 477 pregnant women without GDM (controls) attending public hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
finding: Maternal obesity (MUAC>=31) was significantly associated with the development of GDM, while overweight was not, and previous caesarean section, inadequate dietary diversification, and low physical activity were also associated factors.
mod_finding: A previous history of caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of developing GDM (AOR 1.91).
cross-section timing: Data was collected between 10 March and 30 July 2020.
